items.quote: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
items.claim: The text says Lamech fathered a son when he was 182 years old.

items.quote: And he called his name Noah,
items.claim: The text says Lamech named his son Noah.

items.quote: This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
items.claim: When he named Noah, Lamech said Noah would give comfort from the hard work of farming, which was needed because the LORD had cursed the ground.
items.mechanism: Noah would give relief from the hard manual work caused by the cursed ground

items.quote: because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
items.claim: The text says the LORD had cursed the ground, and that this is why working the land was hard.
items.mechanism: The curse on the ground led to hard work and toil
